correctness.rationale: The exact identity T^2+I=T diag(A,A) transports the rank/Jordan structure of A (rank 2 and A^3=abA) into the temporal primary factors. Nonzero ab yields a four-dimensional core factor X^4+(2-ab)X^2+1 and n-2 order-four blocks, with the 1-residue case having two size-two Jordan factors and the 2-residue case four simple order-eight roots. Zero ab yields exact p^3 or two p^2 blocks and remaining p blocks, p=X^2+1. Polynomial multiplicities give E(t), while positivity of Möbius-inverted counts establishes every listed period. Direct tests: 1,176 exact GF(3) nullities and 597,051 exhaustive states, neither extrapolated to infinite dimensions.

value.rationale: For a natural unbounded family of graph-coupled reversible automata and all characteristic-three finite extensions, the theorem gives a complete temporal census rather than mere reversibility. It reveals three sharp parameter regimes, an order-eight versus order-twelve transition, and appearance of primitive periods two, three, six at exactly one resonance class; these are natural dynamical invariants. The result is not a trivial fixed-graph census or code-only observation.
